Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number, catastrophe and corresponding policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Number,
    c.Catastrophe,
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
    + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
    + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
    + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = c.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp2
    ON cp2.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr2
    ON cr2.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Claim_Number,
    c.Catastrophe,
    p.Policy_Number;
